205068.description:
When college student U-Yun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jin-Hyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jin-Hyeong moves in with him, and that’s when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He’s thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having U-Yun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jin-Hyeong’s ideas are, U-Yun doesn’t entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

205909.description:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

205905.description:
After the cataclysmic destruction of Nanhuang Continent, young Xu Qing, the sole survivor, accidentally obtains a mysterious purple crystal, thus beginning his cultivation journey.

To survive, he joins the Thunder Squad, experiencing life-or-death battles and forging deep bonds with his teammates. Through trials and tribulations, Xu Qing transforms from a lone wolf into a warrior protecting others, becoming a top expert in the Eight Sects Alliance through his exceptional wisdom and willpower. Facing his nemesis, he resolutely embarks on a journey to uncover the ultimate secrets of the remnants of the divine face in order to protect those around him.

(Source: Youku, translated)

205966.description:
In a hyper-competitive society, where the gap between rich and poor is widening,a flawless existence are demanded, and only the strongest survive. Struggling and writhing amidst it all, can they reclaim what they've lost...?

Those who possess talent, yet have been pushed aside because of past mistakes or the circumstances they were born into. For them, a new beginning is offered — a hidden street basketball league known as ZERO RISE.

Only those who fight their way to victory can erase their past scars and reclaim the stage. Not only trained basketball players can step into this fight. Risking it all and pushing themselves to the limit, every kind of underdog gathers.

As they fight to RISE up from ZERO.

(Source: ZERO RISE English site)

205941.description:
Looking up, she could see the night sky embracing all that is. In that moment, a thousand emotions crystallized into questions.
Where hang the sun and moon? What canvas depicts the stars? The infinite universe and breadth of time question the smallness of man.
Yet it is these small specimens of mortality who may embark on long voyages, the power to create miracles firmly within their grasp.

(Source: YouTube description)

205374.description: The dead transformed into vengeful spirits, crossing through a gate to bring calamity to the human world. The delivery man Zhang Zha accidentally entered a haunted graveyard, unleashing a disaster as spirits crossed into the human world. A cast of extraordinary figures became involved. Amid a series of battles and adventures, Zhang grew stronger and a modern martial world story filled with mystery and excitement unfolded.

205619.description:
Wisteria, the daughter of a count, secretly has feelings for Bright, a beautiful childhood friend and son of a duke who, unable to use magic, had been conducting forbidden research in the shadows. Devastated when Bright confesses his love for her younger sister, Wisteria is even more hurt when he asks her to take her sister's place as a sacrifice. Is her love for Bright so strong that she will give up her life for him?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

205372.description:
Fate had never been kind to Ji Ning. Wracked by illnesses and infirm his entire life on Earth, Ning knew early on that he would die as a teenager. What he didn’t know was that there really was such a thing as life after death, and that the universe was a far larger place than he thought. A lucky twist of fate (one of the few in Ning’s life) meant that Ning was reborn into a world of Immortals and monsters, of Ki Refiners and powerful Fiendgods, a world where Dynasties lasted for millions of years. A world which is both greater and yet also smaller than he ever could imagine. He would have the opportunity to join them, and in this life, Ning swore to himself, he would never let himself be weak again! The Era he was born into was a Desolate one, but Ning would make it his era.

(Source: Novel Update)
